bagPolicy.summary: Bag checks are conducted at the entrance for safety. Large handbags or rucksacks are discouraged as they delay admission, and bags larger than A4 may be prohibited at some events.
prohibited: Mechanically or electronically operated acoustic devices
All food and drinks from outside
Animals (except guide dogs and assistance dogs)
Racist, xenophobic and radical propaganda materials
Sound and image recording devices for commercial use
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There are 1,300 parking spaces available at myticket Jahrhunderthalle, typically opening 3 hours before events and costing 8 € on-site. VIP guests have designated parking in area A, and accessible parking is available in area B.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in myticket Jahrhunderthalle's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The myticket Jahrhunderthalle offers a variety of food and drink options through its partner Food Affairs, including soft drinks, fine wines, and a selection of spirits. Guests can enjoy Braustübl´ beer from the Darmstädter Privatbrauerei. Premium Lounge guests have access to a fine-dining buffet with corresponding drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by myticket Jahrhunderthalle, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in myticket Jahrhunderthalle's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at myticket Jahrhunderthalle. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at myticket Jahrhunderthalle. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
